label: Quest
description: Marshal Marris places a bounty on Tharil'zun, the cunning leader of the Blackrock outrunners harassing the roads near Stonewatch Keep. Striking him down…
intro: Marshal Marris places a bounty on Tharil'zun, the cunning leader of the Blackrock outrunners harassing the roads near Stonewatch Keep. Striking him down serves as a critical step in breaking the Blackrock clan's hold over northern Redridge. Bringing his severed head back to Lakeshire marks a hard-fought victory for the embattled town watch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep. The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc. Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense. But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc. Well done—I'm sure he didn't go down easy. Here is your reward, friend.
